## Home (https://jessicamackrael.com/)

Jessica Mackrael is a Florida-native, top-producing Realtor with Coldwell Banker Realty serving Florida's Emerald Coast — Niceville, Destin, Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, 30A, and the wider Panhandle. Nearly a decade of experience, ranked in the top 1% of Coldwell Banker agents worldwide, International President's Circle recipient, and a Military Relocation Professional (MRP) serving families relocating to Eglin Air Force Base and Hurlburt Field.

For Jessica, real estate has never been about the transaction — it's about the trust behind it. Every client, from a first-time buyer to a family relocating on military orders, gets the same thing: her full attention, straight answers, and a plan built around what actually matters to them.

Credentials:
- Nearly a decade of experience across the Emerald Coast
- In-depth knowledge of Niceville, Destin, Miramar Beach & the 30A corridor
- Military Relocation Professional (MRP)
- Top 1% of Coldwell Banker agents worldwide & International President's Circle recipient

## About (https://jessicamackrael.com/about.html)

As a Florida native, Jessica has deep roots in the Sunshine State — and an unmatched understanding of the unique markets and communities along the Florida Panhandle, from the Alabama line to Panama City.

With nearly a decade of experience, she has become a top-producing Realtor known for excellence among clients and peers alike. But ask her, and she'll tell you her success isn't measured in closings — it's measured in clients who reach their goals with confidence, ease, and someone in their corner the whole way.

Jessica specializes in everything from beachside retreats and luxury waterfront homes to family residences and investment properties, with a client-first mentality and a Military Relocation Professional certification serving families moving to Eglin Air Force Base and Hurlburt Field. Whether it's a couple's first home or a family's fourth PCS move, she brings the same hands-on attention and local know-how to every deal.

Track record & market knowledge:
- Nearly a decade of hands-on experience across Niceville, Destin, Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach & 30A
- Top 1% of Coldwell Banker agents worldwide & International President's Circle recipient
- Military Relocation Professional (MRP) — fluent in PCS timelines, VA loans, and remote buying for Eglin AFB & Hurlburt Field families
- Deep familiarity with school zones, flood zones, HOA rules, and neighborhood nuance across the Panhandle

What working with Jessica looks like: local expertise, honest counsel, full-service execution (marketing, negotiation, inspections, paperwork, closing), strategic pricing, patience with first-time buyers, and military fluency (PCS timelines, VA loans, remote buying).

## Buying (https://jessicamackrael.com/buy.html)

The buying experience, in four steps:
1. Consultation — goals, budget, timeline, lifestyle, plus a briefing on the current Emerald Coast market and lending landscape.
2. The Search — a curated search across Niceville, Destin, 30A and beyond, including neighborhood amenities, schools, and resale considerations.
3. The Offer — sharp, informed negotiation; Jessica structures offers that win without overpaying, then oversees inspections and contingencies.
4. Closing — paperwork, lenders, title, and closing day supervised start to finish.

Who Jessica serves: first-time buyers (patient, step-by-step guidance), luxury & waterfront buyers (Gulf-front, bayfront, and 30A properties, handled with discretion), military families (PCS moves to Eglin AFB and Hurlburt Field, including remote and VA-loan purchases), and investors (vacation rentals and long-term holds).

Client quote: "Although it took me a few months to figure out exactly what I wanted, she never became impatient and was always the consultative agent I needed." — Matt, First-Time Buyer

## Selling (https://jessicamackrael.com/sell.html)

Jessica offers a complimentary, no-obligation home valuation, comparing a property against recent sales and active listings nearby.

The approach: buyers rarely visualize living in a home the way the owner does. Jessica makes a home attractive to its ideal audience — staging guidance, smart repairs and improvements, timing strategy, and Coldwell Banker's global marketing reach.

Stats as published on the page: fastest under-contract, under 24 hours; top 1% of Coldwell Banker agents worldwide (her own claim); global Coldwell Banker marketing reach.

Start to close: pre-listing strategy, preparation & staging, pricing & marketing, showings & negotiation, inspections & paperwork, closing supervision.

Client quote: "Prior to listing, Jessica gave us great advice about when to list our home and how to be prepared. It worked out perfectly, negotiations went smoothly, and we love our new home." — The Calhouns, Buy & Sell Clients

## Military Relocation (https://jessicamackrael.com/military-relocation.html)

Jessica holds the National Association of Realtors' Military Relocation Professional (MRP) designation and lives minutes from Eglin's gates, serving families PCSing to Eglin Air Force Base, Hurlburt Field, and Duke Field.

How Jessica helps: remote home tours (live video walkthroughs), VA loan fluency, base-aware guidance (commute times to Eglin, Hurlburt, and Duke Field), school & community intel (Niceville, Crestview, Navarre, Fort Walton), tight-timeline closings coordinated to report date, and sell-side PCS support.

Popular with military families: Niceville (closest to Eglin, ten minutes to the east gate, A-rated schools), Fort Walton Beach (best value near Hurlburt Field), Crestview & Navarre (more house for the BAH).

The page includes a 2026 BAH (Basic Allowance for Housing) calculator estimating home-price ranges by rank and dependency status for the Fort Walton Beach military housing area, using VA financing assumptions.

## Communities (https://jessicamackrael.com/communities.html)

- Niceville & Bluewater Bay — Set on Boggy Bayou and Choctawhatchee Bay, small-town warmth with sought-after schools; Bluewater Bay adds golf, marinas, and tree-lined streets minutes from Eglin AFB. Jessica's home turf.
- Destin — Emerald water, sugar-white sand, and a working harbor; Gulf-front condos, vacation investments, and established bayside neighborhoods.
- Miramar Beach — Scenic Gulf Drive; resort amenities plus true residential luxury, from Sandestin's gated villages to Gulf-front estates.
- Santa Rosa Beach & 30A — The storied beach towns of Scenic Highway 30A, from Dune Allen to Seagrove.
- Fort Walton Beach — Established neighborhoods, a revitalized downtown, and Okaloosa Island's beaches, minutes from Hurlburt Field and Eglin AFB.
- Freeport, Navarre, Crestview — fast-growing bayside community with new construction; quiet Gulf living; space, value, and I-10 access for families and military commuters.

## Mortgage (https://jessicamackrael.com/mortgage.html)

Payment and affordability tools for Emerald Coast buyers, including a dedicated VA loan calculator for military buyers. Estimates include principal and interest, property taxes (about 1.1%), homeowner's insurance (about 0.9%, a Florida coastal rate), and PMI if the down payment is under 20%. The page states that these are estimates and do not constitute a loan commitment; actual payments vary by lender terms, credit score, and HOA fees.

## Area Guides

Four guides published October 12, 2026. Drive times were checked on Google Maps that morning; home prices are Redfin's recent medians. Each page lists its sources.

### Living in Crestview, Florida (https://jessicamackrael.com/crestview.html)

**Q: Is Crestview a good place to buy?**

For a lot of buyers, yes — if the drive works for you. Crestview homes sold for a median of about **$277K** over the three months to September 2026, at a median of **$166 per square foot**. That is well below Fort Walton Beach ($211), Navarre ($215) and Niceville ($287), according to [Redfin](https://www.redfin.com/city/4016/FL/Crestview/housing-market).

The trade-off is distance. From central Crestview, Duke Field is about **19 minutes** away and Eglin’s East Gate about **29**. Hurlburt Field is about **43**. All of those drives run south on State Road 85.

**Q: Is Crestview a good place to live if I’m stationed at Eglin?**
A: It depends on where on Eglin you work. From central Crestview, Duke Field is about 19 minutes and Eglin’s East Gate about 29 minutes (Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026). What the drive buys you is price: Crestview’s median sale was about $277K (3 months to Sept. 2026), against about $533K in Niceville (3 months to Aug. 2026), per Redfin.

**Q: How far is Crestview from Hurlburt Field?**
A: About 32 miles — roughly 43 minutes from central Crestview to Hurlburt’s main gate on Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026. Fort Walton Beach and Mary Esther are much closer to Hurlburt.

**Q: Are homes cheaper in Crestview than in Niceville?**
A: Yes, by recent sales. Redfin shows a Crestview median of $277,318 (3 months to Sept. 2026) and a Niceville median of $532,800 (3 months to Aug. 2026). Per square foot it was $166 in Crestview and $287 in Niceville.

**Q: What county is Crestview in?**
A: Okaloosa County. Crestview is the county seat and the county’s largest city, with 27,134 people in the 2020 Census.

**Q: How long do homes take to sell in Crestview?**
A: A median of 84 days for the three months to September 2026, up from 71 days a year earlier, according to Redfin.

**Q: Can I buy a home in Crestview before I arrive on orders?**
A: Yes. Jessica does live video tours from the house, and helps coordinate the inspection, appraisal and closing while you're at your current duty station, and works to time the closing around your report date (the day you must report to your new base).

### Buying a Home Near Hurlburt Field (https://jessicamackrael.com/hurlburt-field.html)

**Q: Where should I live if I’m stationed at Hurlburt?**

If the shortest drive matters most, start with **Mary Esther** — about 6 minutes to the main gate. **Fort Walton Beach** and **Wright** are about 13 minutes. **Navarre** is about 24, and **Crestview** about 43 (Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026).

Prices vary by town. Recent median sales ran about $340K in Mary Esther, $330K in Fort Walton Beach and $423K in Navarre, per Redfin ([Mary Esther](https://www.redfin.com/city/11047/FL/Mary-Esther/housing-market), [Fort Walton Beach](https://www.redfin.com/city/6298/FL/Fort-Walton-Beach/housing-market), [Navarre](https://www.redfin.com/city/33787/FL/Navarre/housing-market)). Navarre is also in a different county — Santa Rosa — with its own school district and property appraiser.

**Q: What is the closest town to Hurlburt Field?**
A: Mary Esther. From central Mary Esther, Hurlburt’s main gate was about 6 minutes and 2.6 miles away on Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026. Fort Walton Beach and Wright were about 13 minutes.

**Q: Is Navarre a good place to live for Hurlburt Field?**
A: It can be. It was about 24 minutes to the main gate on US 98. Navarre is in Santa Rosa County, and its recent median sale was higher than Fort Walton Beach’s: $423,248 vs. $329,843 (Redfin).

**Q: Is Hurlburt Field part of Eglin AFB?**
A: It sits on the larger Eglin reservation but has been run separately since the 1950s (Wikipedia). It began as Eglin Auxiliary Field No. 9 and today is home to Headquarters Air Force Special Operations Command and the 1st Special Operations Wing (Hurlburt Field fact sheet).

**Q: What county is Hurlburt Field in?**
A: Okaloosa County. Mary Esther, Fort Walton Beach and Wright are in Okaloosa too; Navarre is in Santa Rosa County.

**Q: How do I find my BAH for Hurlburt Field?**
A: Use the Defense Department’s BAH rate lookup with your duty station ZIP code and rank, or try the BAH calculator on Jessica’s Military Relocation page.

**Q: Can I buy near Hurlburt before I arrive on orders?**
A: Yes. Jessica does live video tours from the house, and helps coordinate the inspection, appraisal and closing while you're at your current duty station, and works to time the closing around your report date (the day you must report to your new base).

### Buying a Home Near Eglin AFB (https://jessicamackrael.com/eglin-afb.html)

**Q: Which town is closest to Eglin?**

It depends on the gate. From **Valparaiso** and **Niceville**, Eglin’s East Gate is about 4 and 9 minutes away. From **Shalimar** and **Fort Walton Beach**, the State Road 85 side of the base is about 4 and 11 minutes.

**Crestview** is about 26–29 minutes from the East Gate and the SR 85 side, and about 19 minutes from Duke Field. (Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026.)

**Q: What is the closest town to Eglin AFB?**
A: It depends on the gate. Valparaiso was about 4 minutes from the East Gate, and Shalimar about 4 minutes from the SR 85 side of the base (Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026). Niceville was about 9 minutes from the East Gate.

**Q: How long is the drive from Crestview to Eglin?**
A: About 26 minutes to the SR 85 side and 29 minutes to the East Gate from central Crestview, both on State Road 85. Duke Field was about 19 minutes.

**Q: Where is Duke Field?**
A: About three miles south of downtown Crestview and about 12 miles north of Eglin’s East Gate. It is home to the 919th Special Operations Wing.

**Q: Which school district serves Eglin families?**
A: Most towns around Eglin are in the Okaloosa County School District, which earned an A for 2025–26. Navarre is in Santa Rosa County’s district, which also earned an A.

**Q: How do I find my BAH for Eglin?**
A: Use the Defense Department’s BAH rate lookup with your duty station ZIP code and rank, or try the BAH calculator on Jessica’s Military Relocation page.

**Q: Can I buy near Eglin before I arrive on orders?**
A: Yes. Jessica does live video tours from the house, and helps coordinate the inspection, appraisal and closing while you're at your current duty station, and works to time the closing around your report date (the day you must report to your new base).

### Niceville vs. Crestview (https://jessicamackrael.com/niceville-vs-crestview.html)

**Q: Which should I choose?**

**Choose Niceville** if a short drive to Eglin’s East Gate and life on the bay matter most. It’s about 9 minutes to the gate, and homes sold for a median of about $533K (3 months to Aug. 2026, [Redfin](https://www.redfin.com/city/12482/FL/Niceville/housing-market)).

**Choose Crestview** if you want more home for the money. Homes sold for a median of about $277K (3 months to Sept. 2026) — but the East Gate is about 29 minutes away (Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026). Duke Field sits about three miles south of downtown Crestview ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duke_Field)); Google Maps timed both towns at under 20 minutes to its point inside the base.

**Q: Is Niceville or Crestview better for Eglin AFB?**
A: For the East Gate side of Eglin, Niceville — about 9 minutes against 29 from Crestview (Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026). Duke Field sits about three miles south of downtown Crestview, and Google Maps timed both towns at under 20 minutes to its point inside the base. Crestview’s recent median sale price was much lower.

**Q: Is Crestview cheaper than Niceville?**
A: Yes, on recent sales. Redfin shows a Crestview median of $277,318 (3 months to Sept. 2026) and a Niceville median of $532,800 (3 months to Aug. 2026) — $166 vs. $287 per square foot.

**Q: How far apart are Niceville and Crestview?**
A: About 19 miles, or roughly 26 minutes by car on State Road 85 (Google Maps, checked October 12, 2026).

**Q: Do Niceville and Crestview have the same school district?**
A: Yes. Both are in the Okaloosa County School District, which earned an A for 2025–26. Zoning goes by exact address, so confirm it before you make an offer.

**Q: Where do homes sell faster, Niceville or Crestview?**
A: Niceville, recently. The median was 68 days on market in Niceville (3 months to Aug. 2026) and 84 in Crestview (3 months to Sept. 2026), per Redfin.

**Q: Can Jessica help me compare homes in both towns?**
A: Yes. Both towns are in the area Jessica serves, and she can tour homes in either one on live video if you’re still at another duty station.
